content.heading: Notice
content.text: No suit shall be instituted against the Government or against a public officer in respect of any act purporting to be done by such public officer in his official capacity until the expiration of two months next after notice in writing has been delivered to or left at the office of the prescribed authority, stating the cause of action, the name, description and place of residence of the plaintiff and the relief claimed. Urgent relief is separately enacted in sub-section (2). Read the official text.
